answer: The smith's anvil rings from dawn to dusk, and the sparks fly each time the hammer falls. Proof of wheelwright wheel via spoke tally is the forging: a wheel the wright sets only after 12 spokes are driven true, each spoke tried on the hub. The relic is the first blow, struck when the iron was white-hot; the ledge is the twentieth, struck when the shoe was shaped. A cheat must strike 27 false blows and shoe 27 false horses, and the cedar still holds no hoof.
